title: RepairCase
description: One experimental unit in the behavioural repairability study: a structurally valid, behaviourally deficient candidate FSM, frozen specification, oracle linkage, structural diagnostics, and optional repair outcome record.

case_id.description: Stable identifier unique within the study corpus.

system_id.description: Identifier of the source behavioural system or task family (not an engine or model id).

requirement_text.description: Frozen natural-language behavioural requirement used to derive oracles and gold reference.

gold_fsm_path.description: Relative path to the reference (gold) FSM JSON conforming to fsm.schema.json.

candidate_fsm_path.description: Relative path to the initial candidate FSM at study entry (structurally valid, behaviourally incorrect).

initial_bpr.description: BPR(M_0, O_c) at study entry; must be strictly less than 1 for eligible cases.

oracle_suite_id.description: Identifier of the oracle suite under datasets/oracle_suites/.

failed_tests.description: Oracle checks that fail against the initial candidate (check_id order preserved).

passed_tests.description: Oracle checks that pass against the initial candidate.

missing_transitions.description: Transitions present in gold but absent in candidate (structural–behavioural diagnostic).

extra_transitions.description: Transitions present in candidate but absent in gold (spurious or divergent structure).

repair_history.description: Ordered record of repair iterations; empty at case freeze before any repair run.

final_bpr.description: BPR of the terminal candidate after the last recorded repair; null if no repair has been executed.

final_status.description: Terminal repair outcome label for the case record (see docs/repair_case_format.md).

structurally_valid.description: Admission gate: candidate must be structurally valid at entry.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the case bundle was frozen.

checksums.description: Optional content hashes for long-term integrity verification.

provenance.description: Summarized provenance without raw generation logs.

relative_path.description: POSIX-style relative path from the case directory root; no parent segments (..).

check_type.description: Optional mirror of oracle suite check type (e.g. trace, io_sequence).

summary.description: Short frozen diagnostic; not a live recompute.

condition_id.description: Repair condition under which this iteration was executed.

patch_path.description: Relative path to patch JSON applied in this iteration, if any.

candidate_fsm_path_after.description: Relative path to candidate FSM after this iteration.

regression.description: True iff bpr_after < bpr_before when bpr_before is present.
